name: Pard's Saddlery and Boots
summary: Pard's Saddlery and Boots is a specialized Western wear and equestrian retailer in Pilot Point, Texas, offering an extensive selection of cowboy boots, saddles, hats, and Western apparel for the entire family. With both new and pre-owned saddles, quality footwear brands, and expert customer service, this highly-rated store serves the North Texas equestrian and Western lifestyle community.
demographics: Pard's Saddlery and Boots serves a specialized customer base of equestrian enthusiasts, ranchers, and Western lifestyle consumers in the Pilot Point area and broader North Texas region. The primary demographic includes middle to upper-middle income families with rural or semi-rural lifestyles, typically aged 25-65, who value quality Western wear, authentic cowboy boots, and equestrian equipment. The trade area draws from Denton County's growing population of horse owners, rodeo participants, and those embracing the Texas Western heritage, with customers willing to travel from surrounding communities for specialized saddlery products and expert fitting services.
description: Pard's Saddlery and Boots is a premier Western wear and equestrian specialty retailer located in Pilot Point, Texas, serving the North Texas community with authentic cowboy boots, saddles, and Western apparel since its establishment. This family-oriented store has built a reputation for quality craftsmanship and expert knowledge, offering an extensive selection of footwear for men, women, and children, including cowboy and cowgirl boots from top brands, work boots, and casual Western shoes. Beyond footwear, Pard's specializes in both new and pre-owned saddles, complete with a full range of saddle accessories including billets, girths, breast collars, and stirrups to meet the needs of serious riders and ranchers. The store's comprehensive inventory extends to Western fashion, featuring jeans, shirts, outerwear, and accessories such as felt and straw hats, belts, buckles, jewelry, and purses for the entire family. With a 4.8-star rating and personalized customer service, Pard's has become a trusted destination for those seeking authentic Western lifestyle products, boot care supplies, and expert advice on equestrian equipment in the heart of Texas horse country.
